jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant in Charleroi - Industry sector
Project Finance in Charleroi - Industry sector

jobs.description:
Our client is an energy company.

Jobomschrijving

You will work closely with cross-functional teams including development, engineering, finance, tax, legal and operations, and senior management, while collaborating with external advisors, lenders, investors and counterparties to deliver strategic projects and transactions.

• Buy-side M&A transaction: Together with the Director, leading financial appraisal, due diligence, and structuring of BESS and PV transactions.
• Modelling: Build and stress-test investment models (revenue, degradation, volatility, constraints) and translate outputs into clear investment recommendations and strategic decision making to the Director.
• Negotiation: Together with Senior Legal evaluate, negotiate, and optimize key project contracts (PPA, tolling, EPC, O&M/LTSA) through a risk-return lens to protect capital and increase value.
• Project Financing: Ensure projects meet international project finance bankability requirements and optimize cost of capital through robust structuring - in charge of document negotiation with equity and debt providers.
• Strategy: Contribute to portfolio strategy by assessing future risks and opportunities (e.g., grid connection models, longer duration assets, alternative technologies, new jurisdictions).
• Monitoring: Monitor execution and early operational performance, validating investment assumptions and driving feedback loops into future decisions (ie. monitoring actual portfolio performance against budgets and forecasts, preparing performance reports including key financial and business metrics).
• Invoices & Budget: Oversees (and be responsible for) cost control, invoice tracking, annual budgeting and financial reporting.

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or related field.
• 7-10 years of experience in investment banking, other forms of M&A advisory, project finance, valuation, ideally with exposure and/or strong interest for renewable energy and energy transition
• Strong financial modelling skills and an understanding of project and corporate finance
• Excellent analytical and presentation skills
• Ability to manage work under pressure in a collaborative environment
• Commercial, outward looking, and focusing on adding value
• Strong critical thinking and willingness to challenge assumptions constructively across the team (technical, development, commercial)
• Excellent communication, organisational and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build relationships across internal and external stakeholders
• Fluency in English. French or Dutch is a plus.

Our client is a large organization recognized for its expertise and commitment to excellence.

Jobomschrijving

As a KAM your responsibilities are:

• Manage and develop a portfolio of key accounts 
• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to ensure customer satisfaction and loyalty.

A successful KAM should have:

• Fluency in French, Dutch, and English, with excellent communication skills in all three languages.
• Proven experience in managing key accounts 
• Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills.
• Ability to work independently and take initiative in a fast-paced environment.
• Proficiency in analyzing sales data and market trends.
• Customer-focused attitude with a commitment to delivering high-quality service.

• Act as coach, and inspiration source for the team

• Proven experience in managing teams
• Strong sales mindset 
• Experience in B2B direct sales environments
• Affinity with construction sector is a plus
• Strong coaching capabilities
• Resilient, ambitious, transparent, and hands-on
• Analytical, structured, and result-oriented
• Excellent communication skills
• Fluent in Dutch, English - French is a strong asset

jobs.occupation: Legal Counsel - International clients - Flemish Brabant
jobs.description:
Our client is a highly respected Belgian boutique advisory firm founded by two former lawyers from leading international law firms. The organization supports high-profile prestigious clients and their families throughout every stage of their personal and professional journey.

Combining legal expertise, wealth structuring coordination, contract advisory, estate planning support, tax coordination, and day-to-day administrative assistance, the firm delivers a unique and highly personalized service to a portfolio of more than 100 clients across Belgium and internationally.

With a close-knit team of around 10-15 professionals, the company offers an entrepreneurial environment where quality, trust, and excellence are at the heart of everything they do.

Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Counsel your responsibilities are:

• Advise and assist clients on a wide range of legal matters.
• Review, draft, and coordinate contractual documentation.
• Support matters relating to estate planning, wealth structuring, insurance, and family law.
• Coordinate real estate transactions, including purchase agreements, leases, and notarial processes.
• Liaise with external advisors including notaries, tax experts, accountants, and legal counsel.
• Provide practical support regarding social security, invoicing, and administrative matters.
• Organize and structure client files while ensuring excellent follow-up.
• Monitor deadlines, legal documentation, and ongoing projects.
• Deliver pragmatic and solutions-oriented legal guidance.
• Communicate legal concepts in a simple and accessible manner.

A successful Legal Counsel should have:

• Belgian Master's degree in Law 
• Legal professional as from 3 years of experience are welcome to apply.
• Strong analytical skills and legal reasoning.
• Excellent organizational and planning abilities.
• Detail-oriented, critical thinker, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Fluent in Dutch & English
• Proactive and hands-on personality.
• Mature enough to work autonomously while knowing when to seek guidance.
• Genuine willingness to learn and develop.
• Comfortable working in an environment where responsibility comes early.

Our client is an international law firm based in Brussels.

jobs.occupation: Bus Mechanic – good salary + training opportunies
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working on vehicles and solving technical problems? In this role as a bus mechanic, you ensure that coaches are safe, reliable and ready for daily operations.

• You carry out maintenance and repairs on buses.

• You diagnose mechanical issues and fix them efficiently.

• You perform preventive maintenance to keep vehicles in top condition.

• You work on a varied fleet of different brands and models.

• You ensure every vehicle meets safety and quality standards.

• You have a background in mechanics (experience is a strong plus).

• You can work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.

• You are able to identify and solve technical problems.

• You are eager to learn and interested in new vehicle technologies (like electricity).

• You are open to following additional training.

• You speak Dutch or English.

• You are flexible with working hours while valuing a good work-life balance.

• A driving license D is a plus.

Are you technically skilled, detail-oriented, and looking for a varied role in a warm, family-owned company? Then this position as Mould Technician could be the perfect fit for you!

In this role, you will be responsible for the correct assembly and disassembly of moulds. Every changeover is carried out with great attention to detail and in line with established procedures, ensuring that all equipment remains in perfect condition. Careful handling and precision are key.

After a thorough onboarding period and once you have gained sufficient experience, you will also be responsible for restarting machines after a changeover. In addition, you will support the mould department with various tasks such as:

• Maintenance and repair of moulds
• Assembling and fine-tuning moulds
• Providing general technical support
• No two days are the same!

• Strong mechanical knowledge is essential
• Able to work very precisely and neatly
• Experience in a similar technical role is an advantage
• Skilled in setting up production machines and tools
• Able to plan efficiently and set priorities, both independently and in a team
• Methodical approach, following procedures with an eye for improvement
• Quick to analyse, report, and adjust when needed
• Positive, constructive attitude
• Good command of English is required, as one colleague communicates exclusively in English
